# Percolation_Threshold

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
The critical occupation probability at which a random network transitions from disconnected clusters to a globally connected component. Determines robustness, routing reachability, and information propagation limits in NoC and TCC interconnects.
